title: BEACON D5 shelter status board (FR-D4-3, FEV-22)
description: The wire shape of the shelter SUPPLY board (src/application/coordination/shelter-status.ts) and of its RFC-4180 CSV export's columns. AGGREGATE-ONLY (Art. XIV): a row is counts plus a ratio — there is no occupant, household or roster field, and deliberately no `geom` (a shelter's precise point stays in the role-gated map projection and never enters a file that leaves the system). Provenance is REQUIRED and typed with the domain's own SOURCE_MODES, because shelters are still hand-seeded (no shelter source adapter exists — findings F-35/F-154) and a board must never read as live data (Art. XVI).

provenanceClaim.description: The rendered provenance sentence. It can only contain the word 'Live' when mode is LIVE.

shelterStatus.description: SHELTER_STATUSES verbatim (src/domain/shelter.ts:9). Pinned to the domain union by test.

available.description: capacity − occupancy; never negative (domain invariant). PHYSICAL spare space, not an intake decision — a CLOSED shelter still reports its empty hall here.

utilization.description: occupancy ÷ capacity, 2 dp; 0 when capacity is 0.

available.description: Σ spare space over ALL shelters, CLOSED ones included — physical space, not intake capacity.

availableOpen.description: Σ spare space at OPEN shelters only — the operationally meaningful figure.

byStatus.description: Shelter COUNT per status; every status key present, zeros included.

mode.description: SOURCE_MODES verbatim (src/domain/source-record.ts:8). Pinned to the domain union by test.

sourceLabel.description: Where the rows came from, in checkable words.

asOf.description: Injected as-of instant — the module never reads a clock.
